niche_preference_profile: This user most consistently prefers interfaces that feel clean, spacious, and clearly organized, with strong visual hierarchy, rounded softer shapes, and either light neutral palettes or polished dark themes when they are focused and atmospheric rather than busy. They repeatedly favor fewer competing elements, clearer grouping, prominent primary actions, breathable spacing, and cards or sections that make scanning easy. They often like rounded cards, pill controls, soft elevation, large imagery, and simplified focal layouts over dense, segmented, text-heavy, or overly utilitarian screens.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers open, breathable layouts with fewer visible elements at once, generous spacing, and reduced crowding rather than dense stacked content.
Prefers strong hierarchy with obvious focal points, clearly separated sections, better grouping, and easier scanability rather than flat or competing emphasis.
Most often prefers light neutral backgrounds with dark text and soft contrast, but also responds positively to polished dark themes when they are cohesive, immersive, and not cluttered.
Prefers rounded cards, pill buttons, softened corners, and generally softer component geometry over sharper rectangular treatments.
Prefers content organized into clear cards, panels, or grouped sections when that improves structure and readability, rather than loose mixed layouts or generic lists.
Prefers obvious, emphasized primary CTAs and action controls that are easy to find and visually prioritized over weaker, smaller, or less clearly framed actions.
Prefers larger, more prominent imagery or illustrations with a warm, polished, or atmospheric feel rather than small thumbnails, generic icons, or visually cold imagery.
